# sqlpipe v2.0

Version 2.0 changes the user API, adds an incremental mode, and speeds up Parquet writes.

## Breaking changes

The `/v2/users` endpoint now returns `first_name` and `last_name`. It does not return `name`. If your client reads `name`, update it to read the two new fields.

## New features

The `--incremental` flag copies only the rows that changed since the last run. When you sync a large table on a schedule, use this flag. The flag copies less data than a full sync.

## Performance

Parquet writes are 40 percent faster than in v1. Large exports finish in less time.
